title: Zimra
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Rabbi Yose ben Zimra the Kohen. Hyman says that Zimra’s granddaughter, the daughter of Rabbi Yose ben Zimra, married the son of our holy Rabbi, citing [Yoma 78a](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.78a.13) and [Ketubot 62b](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.62b.8).[^1][^2]

notes.text: Yoma calls Rabbi Yose ben Zimra a priest.
Ketubot says Rabbi arranged his son’s marriage into Rabbi Yose ben Zimra’s household. Hyman identifies the bride more specifically as Zimra’s granddaughter.
